## Motivation

What problem is being solved, and why is the change needed?

## Public Interfaces

Which public APIs, plugin SPIs, configuration options, REST interfaces, persisted
formats, checkpoints, monitoring surfaces or CLI contracts are added, removed or
changed? State "None" when there is no public interface change.

## Proposed Changes

Explain the proposed design in proportion to its scope. Describe the externally
important architecture and behavior, not a class-by-class implementation tour.

## Compatibility, Deprecation, and Migration Plan

Who is affected? How are existing integrations, data and versions migrated?
What is deprecated or incompatible, and when does old behavior go away?

## Test Plan

Describe how observable behavior and compatibility will be verified, including
system/integration tests where relevant.

## Rejected Alternatives

Identify meaningful alternatives and explain why they were not selected.
